notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.2.1 is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/12db318ddea328cb3afe403780d3a4f2f2f4ca23.jpg

The v1.2.1 update is live! 🍖

Hello there!
We're excited to bring you a brand new update for Stone Age: Digital Edition! This time, we've focused on enhancing your experience in local multiplayer and have also made a small fix regarding localization.
Thank you for all your feedback - it has made it easier for us to improve the game. You are the best!
Now, let’s dive into the changelog! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/c86b1341e13b03c35f655d722cdcda9c10ba375f.png

[Feature] Added a feature where players in a local multiplayer game must confirm that it is their turn.
[Fix] Resolved an issue where the game could become unresponsive during the 'Confirm End Game' phase if a local multiplayer game was loaded after the first player made their turn but didn't confirm it.
[Fix] Fixed incorrect button localizations for non-English languages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/472a3dff275f9452d15b5d46093944e3eb58cb62.png

That's it for today! 💪
Thank you for your feedback and support for Stone Age: Digital Edition. We hope you're having a blast playing the game. Don’t forget to follow us on X, Facebook, and join our Discord server!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1b17f3be82b3f53700d14fea410b82c66e78a160.png

[Fix] Addressed graphical artifacts present during replay and Feeding phase.

That's all for today! Compete with each other in the Stone Age and enjoy the game! We're always happy to hear from you, so feel free to drop us a comment or leave feedback via the in-game feature! 🎮

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.1.9 is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/12db318ddea328cb3afe403780d3a4f2f2f4ca23.jpg

The v1.1.9 update is live! 🍖

The last few weeks have been truly special for Stone Age: Digital Edition. We've wrapped up our mobile beta tests and launched the game on iOS and Android! 📱 But we don't intend to slow down now. Based on users feedback, we've prepared a brand new update. 
Here's what you can expect! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/f8ed9251dc7f21c6973710a81bb3351b04f96ead.jpg

[QoL] AI players are now easily distinguishable thanks to a newly introduced icon in the Final Scoring.
[QoL] Implemented minor visual adjustments to the cards panel for a cleaner and more intuitive interface.
[QoL] Improved the readability of Culture Symbols in the player's panel.
[QoL] Added the ability to skip animations for gaining production, tools, and workers.
[QoL] Improved the refreshing mechanism of tools in the player panel during the Collecting Workers phase.
[Fix] Addressed an issue where triggering the "Undo" action immediately after dice rolls led to animation glitches.
[Fix] Resolved rare occurrences where players could get stuck after skipping Collecting Workers phase animations.
[Fix] Fixed an issue where the window informing about another player leaving the online game was displayed incorrectly.
[Fix] Fixed a bug that caused incorrect highlighting of the player panel, improving interface clarity.
[Fix] Ensured that arrows in the tutorial window (accessible via the Menu) are now functioning correctly.
[Fix] Addressed stability issues on mobile devices to provide a more reliable experience across all platforms.
[Fix] Corrected the display of the Clay icon in building tooltips for accurate resource identification.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/472a3dff275f9452d15b5d46093944e3eb58cb62.png

Tomorrow, Stone Age will premiere on the Nintendo Switch, aligning with the conclusion of the Pre-Order phase. 🎮

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/277b19d6a18c279a9ddebcb70c6f0b5845a3fa13.png

We're excited to see the successes you'll achieve as you steer toward flourishing in the Stone Age!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1b17f3be82b3f53700d14fea410b82c66e78a160.png

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.1.5 and mobile beta tests launch!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/12db318ddea328cb3afe403780d3a4f2f2f4ca23.jpg

Greetings, Stone Age Fans!

We're thrilled to announce that update 1.1.5 is live and comes packed with improvements, and tweaks that will enhance your journey. This update is a stepping stone towards an even greater experience, with fixes and enhancements based on your invaluable feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/850047749b55f3983dce014c7700acccc6f13b53.jpg

[QoL] If you attempt to log in without accepting the Privacy Policy, a popup will notify you to do so.
[QoL] We've improved the layout of the Live Scoring window on smaller screens for a better viewing experience.
[QoL] Added functionality to return to the previous window using the R3 button, making navigation smoother.
[QoL] Resolved an issue where the online user list wouldn't refresh after launching a gameplay scene.
[QoL] Added shadows to numbers with laurels for better visibility.
[QoL] Updated localization.
[QoL-Controller] Improved control in the user details popup in the lobby for easier navigation.
[QoL-Controller] Updated the skip icon.
[QoL-Controller] Enhanced controls in the user list within the lobby for better usability.
[Fix] Fixed minor text errors across the game.
[Fix] Fixed a bug that caused invisible animated objects to block player interactions with the board.
[Fix] Fixed minor visual glitches during the Feeding phase.
[Fix-Controller] Fixed an issue with gamepad selection when opening and closing the Harbour panel during building.
[Fix-Controller] Changed gamepad navigation in upper panel buttons for a more intuitive experience.
[Fix-Controller] Removed the hold icon on the confirm button for actions requiring window minimize/maximize.
[Fix-Controller] Fixed the display of help information.

Mobile Beta Testing Has Started!

The beta tests for our mobile version have officially commenced. This is a unique opportunity to get a firsthand look at the game's mobile adaptation and help shape its development.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/f5841671aacfcb55d4207e96c2bc421fe2c1bcf9.png

Check Your Email: Invitations have been sent out! If you've signed up for the beta, please check your email (and don't forget the spam folder) for your confirmation. Your feedback will be invaluable as we polish the mobile experience to perfection.

Join Our Beta Tests Discord Server: Engage with a community of like-minded testers, share your insights, and get direct support from the development team. This is your chance to contribute to the game's growth and make your mark on its journey. Don't miss out!

discord.gg/mNXayWYC4U


We're eager to hear your thoughts and feedback on both the 1.1.5 update and the mobile beta. Your input is crucial in our quest to make Stone Age: Digital Edition the best it can be. So dive in, explore the changes, and let us know what you think!

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Happy gaming!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/472a3dff275f9452d15b5d46093944e3eb58cb62.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1b17f3be82b3f53700d14fea410b82c66e78a160.png

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.1.4 is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/12db318ddea328cb3afe403780d3a4f2f2f4ca23.jpg

The v1.1.4 update is live! 🥳

Here is the first 2024 Stone Age update! We are excited to share all the changes with you and make the game even more enjoyable!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/b71fbcd840400072ca50902959b9dec7161e0889.jpg

[Feature] AI optimization - now it will work much faster!
[Feature] Points in Players' Panel are now animated in realtime.
[Feature] Points penalties are now displayed as a separate category in the Final Scoring.
[Feature] Added a new hint appearing when selecting a tool that has already been used.
[Feature] Updated the layout of the Harbor's.
[Feature] Changed the sound of the Roll Dice button.
[Feature] Changed fire animation in Feeding phase.
[QoL] Improved the readability of various UI elements.
[QoL] Summary of the Feeding Workers phase now shows at this same time for all players at once.
[QoL] Implemented changes for selecting players simultaneously while using the controller.
[QoL] Reworked the skipping of AI animations in Collecting Workers phase.
[QoL] Updated the visuals of one-time-use tools to make it easier to distinguish them from different types of tools.
[QoL] Applied changes to the highlight of location names.
[QoL] The clickability of buttons has been improved.
[Fix] An issue making the workers sent by AI dissapear has been fixed.
[Fix] From now on local player's meeples won't dissapear before collecting them.
[Fix] A bug causing the Join button to not work has been fixed.
[Fix] Fixed a bug appearing after other player abandoned the game (or was kicked out due to the inactivity).
[Fix] From now on Hut won't be highlighted when entering scene.
[Fix] An End Game popup closing during replays and/or skips has been fixed. 
[Fix] Fixed the visibility of collecting goods indicators "+" and "-" when the Collecting Workers phase is skipped.
[Fix] A bug making the workers stay on screen when the Feeding Workers phase was skipped immediately has been fixed.
[Fix] If you have a card with the "Gain any goods" effect, but didn't use it, those goods will be automatically converted to Gold if the game ends.
[Fix] Fixed a bug which caused dice number changing to the wrong values during goods collection.
[Fix] A bug appearing when the player entered Live Scoring windows during the last chapter of the tutorial has been fixed.
[Fix] The behavior of the slider in the Settings window has been fixed.
[Fix] Updated localization.
[Fix] When scrolling the board using the keyboard, the pointer will no longer lose focus on its current location.
[Fix] Pressing Escape on keyboard when a card description is open will now close the card description window instead of the Harbor.
[Fix] Bug that caused dice to be invisible after replay has been fixed.
[Fix] Bug that caused the game to freeze when a player was rapidly adding and/or removing meeples from a location has been fixed.
[Fix] The appearance of artifacts in board animations has been fixed.
[Fix] Fixed the delay of refreshing players order.
[Fix] Made images in dialogs in tutorial bigger for better readability.
[Fix-Controller] Fixed the camera movement while using gamepad.
[Fix-Controller] Fixed the visibility of buttons for sending workers when using the controller.

Additionally, we've implemented a major update resulting in the discontinuation and deletion of previous game saves. Attempts to load existing old saves will be unsuccessful.

There is more news to come, so stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/472a3dff275f9452d15b5d46093944e3eb58cb62.png

Thank you for your feedback - it helps us improve the game! If you want to support the game, you can always send the feedback via the in-game feature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/1b17f3be82b3f53700d14fea410b82c66e78a160.png

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.1.3 is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/db9fc4b9aa22c394a63bba89894c69a27c28d72b.jpg

The update is here!

Winter is coming and we have an update for you! It is better to play Stone Age than live through it during winter! :) Check out what changed:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/f90d826c604f68ed71d17301f5e32c6768ca6022.jpg

[Feature] New animations when you buy a card have been implemented.
Buying cards should be exciting! That is why we have added animations that will improve this rewarding process! :D 

[Fix] The popup with end game information in the building tile has been fixed.
[Fix] The warning animation in the hint panel has been changed.
[Fix] The undo button in the end game window has been fixed.
[Fix] Animation optimization has been done, resulting in visible performance improvement on low-end devices.
[Fix] The size of the skip icon in the Confirm button has been changed.
[Fix] The animation of automatic actions in the second phase after skipping the animation of the opponent's movement has been fixed.
[Fix] Buying cards now works properly right after finishing the tutorial.
[Fix] In the Lobby window, one can now see how many free slots are left in a room.
[Fix] An issue with the friends list not loading has been fixed.
[Fix] The visual state of tab buttons in the Lobby in the Cards Panel windows has been changed.
[Fix] Zooming out from a location now zooms out to the camera position before the click, instead of centering on the location.
[Fix] The "opponent turn" popup has been removed.
[Fix-Controller] Sending workers for cards when we have the last workers available has been fixed.
[Fix-Controller] Pad navigation in the Online Game Setup Window has been fixed.
[Fix-Controller] Gamepad fixes, including selectable glow in phase 2, holding the icon in the confirm button, and navigation in the reconnected popup, have been implemented.
[Fix-Controller] Tooltips on the board have been fixed, and the focus on opponents' turns has been corrected.

Expect more updates soon! :) Let us know what you think of the game through the comment section or the feedback feature! (an envelope icon)

[Fix] The color in the points bubble animation has been fixed.
[Fix] The position of the "gain any goods" button in the feeding phase window (small screen) has been fixed.

[Fix] A bug that could lead to the game going into a soft lock state while performing the last turn in a match has been fixed.
[Fix] A bug causing the online game to reload while replaying the last turn in the match has been fixed.
[Fix] Glows in small locations plate have been fixed.
[Fix] In the Tutorial, dialogs no longer cover important elements on small screens.
[Fix] The display of workers in the players' panel has been fixed.

notes.title: Stone Age: Digital Edition update 1.0.10 is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/db9fc4b9aa22c394a63bba89894c69a27c28d72b.jpg

The update is here!

We told our meeples to speed up their work in the Stone Age so your games should be quicker!  :) Check out what changed:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548339/61ee9d1c2e5051b575b55616c1683645ef38bdf9.jpg

[Feature] Animation of rolling dice in location can be skipped now!
[Feature] Animations of workers and goods are faster and more smooth.
[Feature] Village location animations are now faster.
[Feature] Animation of changing between phases is now faster.
[Feature] Animation at the beginning of your turn is now faster and can be skipped.

Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger! Well, I don't know about the first and the last but our animations definitely got better and faster! :) You can now even skip some of them! 

[Fix] The Issue causing dice to be displayed incorrectly after finishing the tutorial has been fixed.

Now the game after the tutorial will be as pleasurable as it should be! :) No more misinforming dice! 🎲

[Fix] The Issue causing the game to not display cards in Harbour has been fixed.
[Fix] Implemented a solution to prevent the game from getting stuck in an endless reloading loop in case an error occurs during the replay of the last made moves.
[Fix] Fixed a bug that could lead to the game entering a soft lock state when attempting to send workers to invalid spaces.
[Fix] Resolved a bug that prevented the AI from responding with a move during phase 2.

Multi or single player?

Tell us in the comments! :D
